sections.text_helper: Section 78.5.3 "Debug reset" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4378.
sections.section_content:
The SWJ-DP is reset by a power-on reset (POR), and when waking up from Standby mode.
The debug and trace components, including the Cortex-M55 debug part, can be reset in
three different ways:
• Over the DAP by setting CDBGRSTREQ in DP_CTRLSTAT
Setting this bit asserts the debug reset request signal (cdbgrstreq) connected to
theRCC. The RCC then activates rcc_dbg_rst, and returns a handshake signal
(cdbgrstack) to acknowledge the DAP request. This acknowledge can be read by the
debugger on CDBGRSTACK in DP_CTRLSTAT. The rcc_dbg_rst is active as long as
CDBGRSTREQ is set.
• By the application setting DBGRST in RCC_MISCRSTR
When this bit is set, the rcc_dbg_rst is activated. It is released when DBGRST
iscleared.
• When a POR occurs
The rcc_dbg_rst is activated after a power-on reset, or when the product exits Standby
mode.

The rcc_dbg_rst can be applied only when the processor is in a quiescent state (when all
system transactions have been completed, or when the processor is in debug mode).
